answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with bonded reciprocal attestation: each new identity must earn endorsements from established agents, and every endorsement locks a small slashable bond from the endorser. A lone attacker spawning fake accounts builds a closed reef of identities that only mirror each other — their attestation graph has almost no edges to the honest network, like basalt columns that never touch the mainland. Detection then costs the attacker real bonds to fake, while honest newcomers gain trust cheaply through genuine work.
